errors.evidence: The word 'съответно' (respectively) incorrectly maps the list of values to the previously listed categories. In the list of categories, 'drugoto' is fifth and 'signali za zabelyazani netochnosti' is sixth. This would map 'drugoto' to a value of 5 and 'signali...' to a value of 1. In the chart, 'друго' has a value of 1 and 'сигнали...' has a value of 5.
